final: SELECT p.death_country, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max) AS average_ratio, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max) / (SELECT AVG(country_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * v2.points_won / v2.points_max) AS country_avg FROM player_award_vote AS v2 JOIN player AS p2 ON p2.player_id = v2.player_id WHERE v2.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v2.points_max != 0 AND v2.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p2.death_country)) AS ratio_to_mean_country_average FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max != 0 AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country
